headline: Fyre Ants Easthampton — $49,158 account is 80 days quiet on a ~39-day cycle, two full cycles late
assessment: Fyre Ants Easthampton is the #6 account of 2026 at $49,158 over 6 orders and normally reorders every ~39 days; it is now 80 days since the last order. action: Joey: get the Fyre Ants buyer on the phone Monday or Tuesday and find out whether they are buying elsewhere or sitting on inventory; log the answer as a note. Matt: if there is no confirmed order by Thursday, call the owner yourself. Joey: convert or delete the 11/01 placeholder.

headline: Embr/Fyre Ants Springfield — $47,851 on only 4 orders, 81 days quiet against a ~39-day cadence
assessment: Springfield is the #8 account of 2026 at $47,851 on just 4 orders, so each order is roughly $12,000 and one missed cycle is a real hole. The last order was 81 days ago on a ~39-day rhythm and the 2026-11-01 Planned placeholder did not convert. Both Fyre Ants locations together are $97,009, 36% of the $269,804 at risk this week.
action: Joey: cover Springfield and Easthampton in the same call this week and ask directly what stalled the 11/01 order; offer fresh samples with the next delivery. Charley: keep the Northampton, Springfield and Easthampton placeholder rows ready to convert the moment an order is confirmed.

headline: Resinate Douglas — the #1 account of 2026 ($92,779) has dropped to $5,104 in the recent window vs $71,377 before

Resinate Northampton ordered on 11/10 and is due again in 7 days on a ~13-day cycle, so the relationship is alive; the drop is Douglas-specific volume.
action: Joey: ask the Douglas buyer this week whether the volume moved to another Resinate location or another supplier, and get the next Douglas order dated. Matt: sit down with Joey on Resinate account-wide — it is the largest dollar risk that is not yet overdue.

headline: Firehouse Hyde Park — $42,152 account is 47 days quiet (usually 31) and just went past due on $6,880

action: Joey: one call this week that does both — confirm the $6,880 is being paid and take the next order. Dan: hold Firehouse at Net 30 with no extension until the $6,880 clears. Joey: convert or delete the 11/10 placeholder.
